chunks: So those who believe in God and hold fast to Him shall indeed be received into His mercy and His grace, and be guided to Him the straight path.
ai.seo_question: What is the reward for those who believe and hold fast to God?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the dual mechanism of divine guidance: internal faith (iman) and external adherence (i'tisam) to God's covenant, often interpreted as the Ahl al-Bayt. It assures believers that their steadfastness results in direct entry into God's mercy, bypassing the complexities of worldly trials, and is guided by the 'Straight Path' (Sirat al-Mustaqim), which is frequently identified with the Prophet and his progeny.
